body:
New project `research/robofab-armbang` (track robofab): follow-up to `robofab-armaccel`. Time-optimal speed profile along the same joint-space line vs min-jerk: six-part carry time falls 21–29%, jaw-force bound rises 1.2–2.4x. Stylised, stdlib only, 14 tests, `python site/build.py` ok. Citations: Bobrow et al. 1985 verified; Pfeiffer & Johanni issue number unconfirmed (noted).
